input.overview: A code change on io-shop stopped the shop from updating each shopper's saved spending-this-month figure when they bought something. Shoppers saw no errors, but for shoppers who made purchases after the change, the saved monthly spend totals stopped matching what they had actually bought. This matters because the parts of the shop that show and check that figure still read the saved copy. The problem has gone on for {duration}. Argus estimates the cost to the shop in takings at {customer_loss}. Nobody was paged, and no on-call incident was linked to this one. Argus did not roll io-shop back itself, because nothing could show within Argus's waiting time whether a rollback would fix the problem. Instead, it recommends rolling io-shop back. Argus also opened a proposed fix, PR #555, as a draft. That fix has not been run, so none of its changes have happened yet.
